description: Defines synchronization primitives and stop event mechanisms using futexes and busy waiting policies, including classes for stop event source and tokens with support for stop requests and observer management.

classes.name: futex_blocker
classes.description: Blocking policy based on Linux futexes for thread synchronization.

classes.name: busy_wait_blocker
classes.description: Blocking policy based on busy waiting with sleep intervals.

classes.name: stop_event_source_impl
classes.description: Template class managing stop signals and observer tokens with different blocking policies.

classes.name: stop_event_token_impl
classes.description: Template class representing an observer token for stop events, managing stop request status and observer count.

methods.name: get_token
methods.description: Creates a new observer token for the stop event source.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Requests all observers to stop and waits until all are reset.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the stop request status, waiting for ongoing stops to complete.

methods.name: was_stop_requested
methods.description: Checks if a stop has been requested.

methods.name: is_stop_requested
methods.description: Checks if the associated stop event source has been stopped.

methods.name: inc_token
methods.description: Increments the observer token count and manages dtor guard.
